How the scores work

Content score: AI evaluates organization (50%) and relevance (50%) against the assigned prompt. It ignores spoken grammar, missing punctuation, filler words, stutters, incomplete phrases, and likely transcription errors.

Speaking score: local audio measurements estimate volume consistency, pitch variation, pauses, and rushing. The editable transcript identifies “um,” “uh,” contextual filler, immediate repetitions, and possible incomplete phrases. Pitch and volume are coaching signals, not judgments of accent, identity, confidence, or ability.
